pages.title: Drumhearts
text: “The drum is not loud. The drum is steady. Be the drum.”

pages.title: Who they are
text: Every engine in the March still keeps the Drumhearts' time. Their craft is **drums and Pulse**: one beat a breath apart, and the copper answers.
Their camps stand in **savanna**, and a second camp keeps the old road on the March steppe.

pages.title: What they want
text: Their reagent is the **Bone Chime**, worth **+8** standing at their hearth.
They also favour a Copper Ingot, Raw Copper or a Copper Resonator: **+3** each. Any other food is worth **+1**, and a charged Pulse Cell **+2 for every 10 Pulse**, up to +8.
Remember the hearth takes at most **60** standing a day from offerings; see [Tribes and standing](standing).

pages.title: What the Elder trades
text: **Guest**: 6 Copper Ingots for a Bone Chime; 3 Copper Ingots for a Copper Resonator.
**Friend**: 2 Attuned Echo for a Pulse Cell; 2 Bone Chimes and 6 Copper Ingots for an Ember Horn.
**Kin**: a Resonant Core for a Greater Pulse Cell; 4 Bound Echo for a Drumheart.

pages.title: Their Mark and totem
text: At **Voice** the Elder gives you the Drumhearts' Tribe Mark. Craft it with a {item:tribalpower:resonance_totem_fire} and two Spiritweave into their [Kinship Totem](kinship_totem).
Beside a Pulse Resonator it is one more voice; beside a station it lends **Fire**.
A charged Pulse Cell pleases the Drumhearts as it pleases every hearth: **+2 for every 10 Pulse**, up to +8. Their Guest trade for Bone Chimes feeds straight back into their reagent.
Kin of the Drumhearts carry their [boon](tribe_boons): a quicker hand: you swing **10%** faster.
